task.title: To enable licenses in Salesforce
task.shortdesc: After you install the X-Author for Excel Salesforce packages, you must send your Org ID

context.p: After you install the X-Author for Excel Salesforce packages, you must send your Org ID to Conga. By default, when X-Author for Excel is installed, the lowest level of license is provisioned. After Conga has upgraded functionality in your environments, take the following steps to enable X-Author functionality according to your license:

step.cmd: Click on the Conga X-Author for Excel tab.

Click Refresh License.
All users connecting to X-Author for Excel are now able to use licensed product features.

result.p: X-Author for Excel is comprised of both Microsoft Dynamics managed solutions and an Excel add-in for each user.
Designers will see both the X-Author Designer and X-Author for Excel tabs in the Excel menu. End users should install the runtime-only add-in and they will see only the X-Author for Excel tab.
